2. Directory Structure

2.1 Mandatory Files

A module requires at least two files:

apps/abpe_ui/templates/abpe_ui/modules/mein_modul/
├── module.json     ← Required: Configuration
└── index.html      ← Required: Main Template

2.2 Complete Structure

A fully developed module looks like this:

apps/abpe_ui/
│
├── templates/abpe_ui/modules/mein_modul/
│   ├── module.json          ← Module Configuration (Required)
│   ├── index.html           ← Main Page
│   ├── detail.html          ← Subpage (optional)
│   └── upload.html          ← Subpage (optional)
│
├── static/abpe_ui/
│   ├── css/mod/
│   │   └── mod-mein_modul.css    ← Module CSS (optional)
│   ├── js/mod/
│   │   └── mod-mein_modul.js     ← Module JS (optional)
│   └── i18n/
│       ├── de/modules/mein_modul.json    ← German
│       ├── en/modules/mein_modul.json    ← English
│       └── fr/modules/mein_modul.json    ← French

2.3 Naming Convention

FilePatternExample
Module Folder{modul_id}cv_editor
CSSmod-{modul_id}.cssmod-cv_editor.css
JavaScriptmod-{modul_id}.jsmod-cv_editor.js
i18n{modul_id}.jsoncv_editor.json
CSS Classes.{prefix}-{name}.cve-container

Important: The modul_id in module.json must exactly match the folder name.

2.4 Create Module — Commands

# 1. Create folder
mkdir -p apps/abpe_ui/templates/abpe_ui/modules/mein_modul

# 2. Mandatory files
touch apps/abpe_ui/templates/abpe_ui/modules/mein_modul/module.json
touch apps/abpe_ui/templates/abpe_ui/modules/mein_modul/index.html

# 3. CSS + JS (optional but recommended)
touch apps/abpe_ui/static/abpe_ui/css/mod/mod-mein_modul.css
touch apps/abpe_ui/static/abpe_ui/js/mod/mod-mein_modul.js

# 4. Language files
touch apps/abpe_ui/static/abpe_ui/i18n/de/modules/mein_modul.json
touch apps/abpe_ui/static/abpe_ui/i18n/en/modules/mein_modul.json
touch apps/abpe_ui/static/abpe_ui/i18n/fr/modules/mein_modul.json

# 5. Restart service
supervisorctl restart abpe-django

2.5 Prefix Convention for All Files

PrefixTypeWhen Loaded
core-*CSS + JSAlways — Core Functionality
ui-*CSS + JSAlways — UI Components
mod-*CSS + JSOnly with active module
lib-*CSS + JSAlways — Third-party
theme-*CSSConditional (Dark/Light)
api-*JSOnly with external calls
